gloss: three years; for three years; period of three years

definitions.gloss: three years; period of three years
definitions.explanation: A duration of three years. The suffix {間|かん} emphasizes a continuous span of time, distinguishing this from {三年|さんねん} which can also mean 'third year.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三年間|さんねんかん}です。
{三年間|さんねんかん}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦していました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was studying abroad for three years.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三年間|さんねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: This research took three years and a great deal of effort.

notes:
Adds the duration suffix ⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ to ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧, making it unambiguously mean 'three years long' rather than 'third year.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {三年間|さんねんかん}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue for three years
- {三年間|さんねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: three years of experience
- {三年間|さんねんかん}⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work for three years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧: three years; third year — shorter form, can be ambiguous between duration and ordinal
- ⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧: third-year student — ordinal, not duration
